citation.authors: Park J, Lyles RH, Bauer-Wu S
citation.journal: American Journal of Physiology: Regulatory, Integrative and Comparative Physiology

record.population: 15 hypertensive African American men with chronic kidney disease
record.design: Randomised crossover: 14 minutes of mindfulness meditation against blood-pressure education; a subset also did controlled breathing
record.finding: Mindfulness meditation lowered blood pressure, heart rate and muscle sympathetic nerve activity. Controlled breathing alone did not reduce blood pressure, heart rate or nerve activity in this study.
record.note: Tiny, acute, crossover; the controlled-breathing arm was a subset. This is a counter-signal to the breathing meta-analysis in this population.

record.population: 15 hypertensive African American men with chronic kidney disease
record.design: Randomised crossover: 14 minutes mindfulness meditation against blood-pressure education
record.finding: Mindfulness meditation acutely lowered systolic and diastolic pressure, heart rate and muscle sympathetic nerve activity compared with the control.
record.note: Acute effect over 14 minutes, not long-term.
